findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous eval/exec usage in protobuf
 * @description Finds any direct use of eval or exec which could lead to code execution if passed untrusted data.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/protobuf-eval-exec
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall()
select call, "Use of eval/exec can lead to code injection if arguments are not trusted."
findings.hypothesis: protobuf might use eval/exec in dynamic message building or reflection

message.text: Use of eval/exec can lead to code injection if arguments are not trusted.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Protobuf: unsafe use of eval/exec
 * @description Detect uses of eval or exec in the protobuf package, which could lead to code injection if arguments are influenced by untrusted input.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/protobuf-eval-exec
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of eval/exec can lead to code injection if arguments are not trusted."
findings.hypothesis: protobuf uses eval/exec, which could enable code injection if passed untrusted data

message.text: Use of eval/exec can lead to code injection if arguments are not trusted.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Protobuf: unsafe dynamic imports
 * @description Detect dynamic imports using __import__ or importlib that may be influenced by untrusted input.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/protobuf-dynamic-import
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("__import__").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("importlib").getMember(["import_module", "__import__"]).getACall()
select call, "Dynamic imports may lead to code execution if module names are not trusted."
findings.hypothesis: Protobuf uses dynamic imports via __import__ or importlib that could be influenced by untrusted input.

message.text: Dynamic imports may lead to code execution if module names are not trusted.
